question: For weekly-sales data, I need an analysis of our sales performance around mid-June for the years 2018, 2019, and 2020. Specifically, calculate the percentage change in sales between the four weeks leading up to June 15 and the four weeks following June 15 for each year.
sql:
WITH pre_post AS (
  SELECT
    calendar_year,
    SUM(CASE
      WHEN (calendar_year = 2018 AND week_date IN ('2018-06-11', '2018-05-28', '2018-05-14', '2018-04-30'))
        OR (calendar_year = 2019 AND week_date IN ('2019-06-10', '2019-06-03', '2019-05-27', '2019-05-20'))
        OR (calendar_year = 2020 AND week_date IN ('2020-06-08', '2020-06-01', '2020-05-25', '2020-05-18'))
      THEN sales ELSE 0 END) AS pre_sales,
    SUM(CASE
      WHEN (calendar_year = 2018 AND week_date IN ('2018-06-18', '2018-06-25', '2018-07-09', '2018-07-23'))
        OR (calendar_year = 2019 AND week_date IN ('2019-06-17', '2019-06-24', '2019-07-01', '2019-07-08'))
        OR (calendar_year = 2020 AND week_date IN ('2020-06-22', '2020-06-29', '2020-07-06', '2020-07-13'))
      THEN sales ELSE 0 END) AS post_sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE calendar_year IN (2018, 2019, 2020)
    AND (
      (calendar_year = 2018 AND week_date IN ('2018-06-11', '2018-05-28', '2018-05-14', '2018-04-30'))
      OR (calendar_year = 2019 AND week_date IN ('2019-06-10', '2019-06-03', '2019-05-27', '2019-05-20'))
      OR (calendar_year = 2020 AND week_date IN ('2020-06-08', '2020-06-01', '2020-05-25', '2020-05-18'))
      OR (calendar_year = 2018 AND week_date IN ('2018-06-18', '2018-06-25', '2018-07-09', '2018-07-23'))
      OR (calendar_year = 2019 AND week_date IN ('2019-06-17', '2019-06-24', '2019-07-01', '2019-07-08'))
      OR (calendar_year = 2020 AND week_date IN ('2020-06-22', '2020-06-29', '2020-07-06', '2020-07-13'))
    )
  GROUP BY calendar_year
)
SELECT
  calendar_year,
  pre_sales,
  post_sales,
  ((1.0 * post_sales - pre_sales) / pre_sales) * 100 AS pct_change
FROM pre_post
ORDER BY calendar_year
